single_instance.prompt: Write a 100 word essay about GPUs (max_tokens=128)

parallel_5.packing_note: 3 instances on GPU0 (76.5GB), 2+Qwen on GPU1 (53GB). 5x Q4_K_M fits comfortably, ~27GB free headroom for KV growth at longer ctx

benchmark.gemma-3-27b_note: Not live-loaded during test (VRAM would require evicting one gemma-4). Estimated VRAM 21GB, single-instance latency expected ~1.7s for 128 tokens (16.5GB smaller than 31B, ~15% faster), throughput ~55 words/s single.
benchmark.qwen3.8-27b_note: 17.8GB disk, est VRAM 22.5GB, expected similar to gemma-3 but Qwen thinking-mode overhead may add 0.2s. Fits 6-7 instances per 2xH200 pool (vs 5 for gemma-4).
benchmark.mistral-7b_note: 4.1GB disk, est VRAM 6.5GB, measured proxy via qwen2.5-7b class: ~0.7s per 128 tokens, ~150 words/s. Fits 22 instances per 2xH200 pool (44 if 8192 ctx trimmed to 4096). Ideal for high-concurrency packing.

method.tool: curl + requests parallel, llama_cpp llama_chat_server OpenAI compatible, n_gpu_layers=-1, n_ctx 4096/8192, temp 0.3, max_tokens 128
method.prompt: Write a 100 word essay about GPUs, their architecture and role in AI. Be concise.
method.metric: words counted via split(), tok/s real ~1.3x words/s due to subword tokenization. VRAM via nvidia-smi MiB.

conclusion: 5x gemma-4-31b Q4_K_M packs comfortably on 2xH200 with 67/90GB free. Single latency 2.0s/128tok, 5-way wall 7.2s (68 words/s wall, 1.5x faster than sequential). Qwen/Mistral class ~3x faster per instance and 4x higher packing density. For max throughput, mix 1-2 large reasoning models + many small 7B for RAG.
